core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gulsana corresponds to the Persian form گلسانہ (Persian گلشن/گلستان + -a). Its core sense is flower garden, rose garden. Gulsana is an extended form in the گل 'flower' family, reported with the sense 'rose garden'. The source gave جلسانة (a different word) as the Arabic form and glossed it 'rose garden'. Because the precise formation is not documented, it is recorded at low confidence.
